    AI Overview
    Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22 to promote environmental protection and sustainability. In 2026, Earth Day falls on Wednesday, April 22, marking its 56th anniversary since the first event in 1970. The 2026 theme focuses on "Our Power, Our Planet". 
    Key details about Earth Day: 
    • Purpose: To raise awareness about environmental issues, such as pollution, climate change, and conservation.
    • Activities: Events include community clean-ups, educational programs, tree planting, and sustainability workshops.
    • Global Scope:
      It is recognized as a major global event, sometimes extending into a full "Earth Week" of activities.
    • History: The first Earth Day was held on April 22, 1970, and is considered the start of the modern environmental movement. 
    You can find local events and ways to participate, such as the activities listed by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, National Park Service, or EarthDay.org.
